pages.https://research.example.org/remote-work:
Remote work productivity

Fully remote teams completed 8% fewer tasks per week in our sample of 40 companies.

Teams with weekly in-person days showed no drop.
pages.https://journal.example.com/hybrid-teams:
Hybrid teams study

Hybrid teams were as productive as office teams over 12 months.

The randomised trial covered 1,600 employees.
